main.description: Trigger the maps-bulk-ingest-ferry-routes K8s pod to (re)ingest OSM Overpass relation[route=ferry] across 7 continent bboxes + ferry_terminal / harbour nodes into vertex_spatial as SeaRoute / Port. Usually fired by the timer-start BPMN of the same name (R/P7D). ODbL.

continents.description: Comma-separated continent slugs (asia,europe,africa,na,sa,oceania,jp) or ALL. Default = ALL.
